label: THE SECOND KEY · SERIAL

slides.text: Next morning, the old man from next door was waiting on her steps. "You have Rukmini's eyes."
Jaffer uncle. Fifty-one years next door. He made chai the way ammamma did: half glass, extra ginger.
Ananya showed him the brass key. His glass stopped halfway. "I haven't seen that since 1984."
"Your ammamma's house never had eleven doors, beta. It had twelve."
"The summer your mother left for Bangalore, she had a mason plaster one over. Upstairs. She never climbed those stairs again."

caption:
Eleven doors. One key that fits none. And a neighbour who remembers a twelfth. 🗝️
